messages:
maya: heads up — CI flagged a regen diff in the CLI types after the auth backoff change. sample-app publish is blocked by the regendiff check.

igor: which job/links? failing step name?

maya: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234  failing step: `typegen:compare`. Diff shows a lot of property reorderings in generated TS types for AuthBackoffOptions. we didn't change any shapes in the openapi.

sam: so semver / changelog question — do we treat this as a breaking change? doesn't feel breaking, just ordering noise.

lee: looks like the generator is serializing object maps using insertion order; the backoff options changed insertion when we refactored defaults -> nondeterministic ordering. That flips the type hash.

maya: I reproduced locally with `yarn regen` and the same diff appears. quick hack: run a stable sort step before serializing. tested with `node scripts/stable-sort.js | yarn regen` and the diff disappears. not a long-term fix.

igor: deploy-bot, any automated note about the blocked publish?

deploy-bot: CI alert: sample-app publish blocked due to regendiff mismatch. job id: 1234. See https://ci.internal/redwood/1234/logs.

anna: short-term unblock options: 1) revert the reorder in auth change, 2) patch typegen to sort keys deterministically, 3) temporarily allow publish with a manual override. prefer (2).

sam: I can do a one-off publish bypass as release-captain (`yarn publish --ignore-regendiff`) but want a release note and sign-off. not ideal to bypass checks.

lee: I'll open a small PR to make the typegen perform deterministic sorting of object properties before emitting types. Add unit that runs regen twice to assert idempotence.

maya: awesome. I'll add a changelog entry: `fix(typegen): deterministic property ordering to avoid spurious regendiffs` and attach to the patch. ETA ~2 hours.

igor: landing order? land typegen fix first, then regen sample-app, then publish.

deploy-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/789 status: draft. CI: typegen tests running.

lee: once PR passes I'll flip it out of draft. test covers `yarn regen --ci` yields zero diffs. also adding a linter rule to catch unsorted map usage in generator code.

anna: also a follow-up: update the onboarding docs for sample-app maintainers to run `yarn regen --ci` and verify against locked snapshots pre-publish. add to release checklist.

maya: agreed. I'll update the checklist and add a small blurb about auth option default ordering.

sam: fine plan. If we need an unblock before fixes land, ping me and I'll do the manual publish with a note.

maya: thanks everyone. filing a short retro item: make regendiff failures actionable with a suggested remediation link in CI logs.

lee: noted. I'll add an item to eng backlog ticket INF-452 to instrument CI with remediation hints.

sam: :thumbsup:

maya: closing loop here — will follow up in PR comments when ready.
